host: 4 vCPUs, the core, the harness and the database on the same host
load: 1,000 resources in one namespace (cap-cliff), the preloaded writes round-robin over them (pruned skeletons, random 20-byte ids), then 100 appends a second for 150 s through the HTTP API, open loop, each to a random resource with no write in flight; latency and I/O counted for the writes after the first 30 s (latency_after_30s, io_per_write_after_30s)
setup: postgres:16 in a container: --memory=256m --memory-swap=256m, shared_buffers=32MB, effective_cache_size=64MB, max_wal_size=512MB, max_connections=300, track_io_timing=on; restarted with the host page cache dropped, then every table and index read once (pg_prewarm 'read', tables first, largest first)
